 Integrate and maintain Exchange APIs through WebSocket and REST, handling sequence gaps, rate limits, partial fills, and clock synchronization.
 



 Design robust transaction and ledger systems using MySQL/InnoDB, ensuring data consistency and correctness.
 



 Build idempotent and fault\\-tolerant services capable of handling at\\-least\\-once infrastructure reliably.
 



 Work with Redis Streams, Pub/Sub, Lua, and transactions for real\\-time data processing and distributed systems.
 



 Develop and optimize WebSocket services capable of supporting high numbers of concurrent connections.

 Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize production systems for latency, scalability, reliability, and resource efficiency.

 4–7\\+ years of backend development experience, with at least 2 years working on latency\\- and correctness\\-sensitive systems such as trading, payments, wallets, or other real\\-money platforms.
 



 Strong production experience with Rust. Candidates with strong systems\\-level experience in C\\+\\+/Go with willingness to work deeply in Rust may also be considered.
 



 Strong understanding of async programming, concurrency, ownership, and memory safety.
 



 Hands\\-on experience integrating Binance, Bybit, or other exchange APIs through WebSocket and REST.
 



 Strong knowledge of MySQL 8 / InnoDB, including row locking, deadlocks, transactions, isolation levels, and high\\-volume batch writes.
 



 Strong understanding of concurrency, idempotency, state machines, and exactly\\-once processing concepts.
 



 Practical experience with Redis, beyond simple caching, including Streams, Pub/Sub, Lua, and atomic operations.
 



 Strong Linux fundamentals and experience with systemd.
 



 Experience with GitHub Actions / CI\\-CD.

 Knowledge of market microstructure, order books, VWAP, slippage, and toxic flow.
 



 Experience building WebSocket infrastructure supporting 10K\\+ concurrent connections.
 



 Experience with ClickHouse or other large\\-scale OLAP systems.
 



 Experience handling critical production incidents involving financial transactions or money movement.
 



 Strong understanding of trading systems and financial data flows.
